an5.60:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajito.
an5.60:1.3: Dullabho bhikkhave vuḍḍhapabbajito suvaco, dullabho suggahītaggāhī, dullabho padakkhiṇaggāhī, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
an5.60:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajito ti.
an5.60:2.4: kumārā Licchavī apare duve ti. 1. Pañc' imā
